about_the_game:
Your dreams begin with a potion... but it's your strategy that takes you to the top.

Potion Rise Simulator – Build a potion empire from scratch!

You start at the bottom... in a small, gloomy port city, in a dilapidated shop. But there is hope in every bottle. Every sale is a step that takes you higher.

Potion Rise Simulator offers a simulation experience where you don't just produce and sell potions; you also grow and develop through your business acumen, strategy, and time management.

Your journey begins in a gloomy port city shrouded in mist, where people live among the shadows. Here, intentions are as murky as words.

But this is just the beginning.

Over time, your fame spreads, your pockets begin to fill, and the doors to new cities awaiting you begin to open.

Each new city means brighter opportunities, more challenging customers, and a more prestigious life.

As a master born from the darkness, can you make your name known throughout the realm?

A process that spans from seed to bottle awaits you.

Elixirs are prepared using plants you grow in your own garden. Product quality is directly proportional to your effort and strategy.

Purchase seeds, grow plants

Prepare more advanced potions with extract production

Manage time effectively, monitor stock levels, plan production

Every potion is a choice. Every sale is a step. Every city is a stage.

As a potion master in Potion Rise Simulator, you prepare your potions using the recipes you discover and place them on your shelves.

Customers come... but they don't all want the same thing.

Some are looking for ordinary solutions, while higher-status customers are only interested in the highest-quality potions.

You decide who you want to attract.

When the right potion reaches the right customer at the right time, both profit and reputation are yours.

So it’s not just about producing—it’s about knowing what to offer, to whom, and when.

Potion Rise Simulator is a multi-layered simulation where you’ll uncover new potion recipes, combinations, and strategies with every playthrough.

Are you ready to start with a small shop and build a real potion empire by increasing your mastery and knowledge?

Mysterious formulas, rare plants, and magical potions await you.

Every bottle is a new adventure; every mixture is a testament to your mastery.

🎯 Add Potion Rise Simulator to your Steam wishlist now and embark on your own alchemy journey!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu ses kartı
  • VR Support: Desteklenmiyor

short_description: From a small shop to a massive potion empire! Grow your plants, brew your potions, choose your customers. Rise from dark harbors to fame with strategy, timing, and wit. The top is in your hands in Potion Rise Simulator — start your journey now!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Romanian, Greek, Czech
